messages:
ci-bot: smoke-integ: hosted-api integration job FAILED on shard-5 (6/8 failed overall). Observed 401s during streaming + tool-call tests. sample log: 
[2026-03-10T14:22:03Z] upstream auth-proxy -> 401 Unauthorized for session=abc123 route=/v1/stream (tool-call).

sam: omg. which tests exactly? streaming-toolcall-schema or auth-handshake?

ci-bot: failing tests: tests/integration/test_streaming_toolcall.py::test_tool_call_auth_timeout and tests/integration/test_schema_enforcement.py::test_stream_body_auth_header. root cause seems auth header missing/invalid when streaming a tool-call payload.

ara: @sam can you kick a rerun for shard-5 first, and if it repros we should bisect between the last two runtime bumps (runtime v1.8.2 -> v1.9.0 deployed ~1hr before failures).

sam: doing a rerun of shard-5 now. ping me if it flakes again.

ryan: FYI i saw a small auth-proxy change that touched header rewriting in the last deploy. putting a note here: https://git.internal/r/proxy/commits/5f2d3 

jin: sharing a quick local repro command that caught the header drop for me earlier: 
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:21:59 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 87
X-Request-Id: req-9b7a
{"error":"missing Authorization header","route":"/v1/stream"}
```

jin: to reproduce: set DEBUG_AUTH_PROXY=1 and run the smoke streaming test against staging-hosted, you'll see the header flow in the proxy logs.

ara: if rerun still fails, can someone capture request/response headers and the exact tool-call payload? need token header + content-type + x-internal-route.

sam: rerun completed: shard-5 FAILED again. same 401. logs attached in CI artifacts: link: https://ci.internal/artifacts/2037654321/shard-5/log.txt : shows auth-proxy returned 401 after redirect to /tools/call.

taylor: can we try forcing the older runtime (v1.8.2) for a quick smoke to confirm cause? i can trigger a canary with pinned runtime on a test run.

ryan: i'm starting a bisect across the runtime commits between v1.8.2..v1.9.0 now (parallel runs for 6 commits). tagging @jin for help with reproducer harness.

jin: thanks. for local bisect use: 
```
export HOSTED_API_URL=https://staging-hosted.api
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --shard=5 --runtime=commit-<hash>
```

sam: also please enable verbose auth logs: ``AUTH_PROXY_DEBUG=1`` when running the harness. captures are saved to /tmp/auth-debug-<ts>.log

ci-bot: rerun job (shard-5) started by ryan at 2037654350, queued.

ara: one-off thought: could the streaming path drop Authorization on 307/308 redirects? iirc we had a proxy rule that strips on cross-host redirects. check redirect code path.

taylor: good catch. i'm going to grep for 307 handling in proxy commits in that window.

ryan: bisect progress: 3/6 runs complete, reproduces on commit c3f4 -> pointing to commit touching proxy redirect logic. collecting diffs.

sam: once bisect finishes, let's open a hotfix PR pinning runtime for hosted smoke and revert the redirect change if confirmed. also notify oncall and product that smoke is red. :warning:

jin: agreed. i'll attach a minimal repro payload and the exact headers we saw so QA can validate once fixed.

ci-bot: bisect finished at 2037654390: culprit commit: proxy: stop forwarding Authorization on 307/308 (commit c3f4b2). Created issue: https://issues.internal/RED-4523 and hotfix branch: hotfix/restore-auth-redirect.

sam: moving to hotfix. thanks everyone for quick triage. :thumbsup:
